outcome: Job coordination state (failure counter, pause reason, setup/notification state) moved out of the free-form target_json blob into dedicated database columns written only by single targeted statements — concurrent writers can no longer silently erase each other's updates, and the failure counter that decides auto-pause now counts every failure. The dead recovery-intent machinery (never called in production since its brief May run) is deleted rather than hardened, and the migration logs-and-drops any inert residue, un-sticking jobs a stale intent was wrongly blocking. Net 286 lines removed.
